title: Concept: Collections status in a response
description: A collections or recovery status field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The status reveals that the account is in arrears and how far the recovery process has gone, which is both a privacy breach and a lever for debt-collection scams.
applicability: Deployments that render a collections or recovery status field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The status reveals that the account is in arrears and how far the recovery process has gone, which is both a privacy breach and a lever for debt-collection scams.
